pluginDescription: Syncs TX-5DR radio frequency and mode to WaveLog in real time, and tunes the radio when a WaveLog Bandmap spot is clicked.
apiUrlDescription: Your own WaveLog address, e.g. https://log.example.com. /index.php/api/radio is appended if missing. Leave empty to disable reporting.
apiKeyDescription: Read/write key created in WaveLog under Admin → API.
radioNameDescription: Name shown in the WaveLog hardware interfaces list.
pollIntervalDescription: How often to check the radio for frequency and mode changes.
heartbeatDescription: Re-send the unchanged state at this interval so WaveLog keeps the radio active. 0 disables it.
callbackEnabledDescription: Listen locally for WaveLog tune callbacks.
callbackHostDescription: 127.0.0.1 by default (same computer only). Use 0.0.0.0 if the browser runs on another computer.
callbackPortDescription: Must match the port in the radio's CAT URL in WaveLog. Default 54321.
snapDigitalDialDescription: In FT8/FT4 mode, a spot within 0–3.5 kHz above a standard dial frequency tunes to that dial frequency (e.g. 14.074 MHz).
